Resources

The mark, the wordmark and the data behind every figure are free to download

Use them in talks, papers and posts about the project, and say where they came from.

LogoDataResearch files

01Logo

One drawing, two ways of seeing it

The mark is a Necker cube: the same lines can be seen with either face in front, and the view flips while the drawing stays still. Same input, a different experience, which is the puzzle this project works on.

  • open-mind-mark.svgThe mark, SVG
  • open-mind-wordmark.svgThe wordmark with the mark, SVG
  • open-mind-wordmark-text.svgThe lettering alone, SVG

All three are single-colour line drawings; change the stroke colour to suit your background. Please do not use them in a way that suggests you speak for the project.

02Data

The counts behind every figure on this site

  • counts.jsonEvery count behind the data figures: recordings by dataset and kind of label, report-labelled awakenings by stage and lab. From experiments/ground_truth/counts.json, 3 KB
  • labels.csvOne row per open recording or awakening, 3,679 rows: dataset, lab, subject, stage, behaviour, report and kind of ground truth. From experiments/ground_truth/labels.csv, 557 KB
  • dream_access.csvEach DREAM package: live access check, licence, size and report counts by stage. From experiments/data_access/dream_access.csv, 2 KB
  • dream_sets.csvPer-set counts, sample rate, channels, size and licence for the DREAM database. From experiments/dataset_audit/dream_sets.csv, 2 KB
  • DATASETS.mdThe dataset audit: what is open, what is restricted, and what each dataset can test. From docs/DATASETS.md, 16 KB

These are our own tables, built from public metadata. The recordings themselves belong to their authors; the Data page lists every dataset, where it lives and under which terms.

03Files

Every result has its own folder with code and a written verdict

  • Blind strict scoring of T1, T2, IIT 4.0 and GNWT (task #30)
    experiments/blind_scoring/RESULTS.md
  • Chennu 2016 propofol EEG within the download budget (task #21)
    experiments/chennu_access/RESULTS.md    Solved without a lead decision.
  • Constraint ledger (task #24, track B1)
    experiments/constraint_ledger/RESULTS.md    The ledger has 59 constraints: 19 graded A, 30 graded B and 10 graded C.
  • Data access: DREAM audit, ketamine, COGITATE, outreach (tasks #19, #20)
    experiments/data_access/RESULTS.md    No data was granted today.
  • Dataset audit (task #2)
    experiments/dataset_audit/RESULTS.md    The root goal's data criterion fails as written.
  • Ground-truth schema (task #3)
    experiments/ground_truth/RESULTS.md    2,417 open delayed-report (L2) cases exist, and all of them are sleep awakenings in the DREAM database.
  • Does Lempel-Ziv complexity add anything over the spectral exponent? Sleep-EDF (task #4, first dataset)
    experiments/lz_slope/RESULTS.md    No, once the spectrum is described properly. Against the full spectral baseline (the exponent plus six band powers), LZ adds nothing. In wake vs N3 the change is +0.0004 AUC (p = 0.19); in REM vs N3 it is -0.0002 (p = 0.16). Against the 1-40 Hz exponent alone, LZ adds 0.061 AUC for REM vs N3 (0.915 to 0.976, Holm p = 0.008). That is the one cell that meets the sealed pass mark. But LZ failed the surrogate gate (task #8), and the gain vanishes when band powers are added, so it is spectral shape the single exponent misses, not complexity beyond the spectrum. In wake vs N3 the exponent alone is already at AUC 0.988, which leaves no room: LZ adds 0.007, below the 0.01 mark.
  • Non-equilibrium (time-irreversibility) EEG measures vs the spectrum: results
    experiments/nonequilibrium/RESULTS.md
  • Research sweep and citation check (tasks #12, #13)
    experiments/research_sweep/RESULTS.md    Every "(memory)" citation in docs/fable_plan.md is real and now has a DOI.
  • Rules of evidence and leakage check (task #1)
    experiments/rules/RESULTS.md    The toolkit catches every planted leak in the dry run (PASS).
  • Surrogate gate on Sleep-EDF (task #8)
    experiments/surrogate_gate/RESULTS.md    Every measure that tells wake from N3 fails the gate. Lempel-Ziv complexity behaves like the spectrum. Phase-randomised surrogates of wake EEG keep their spectrum but lose all nonlinear structure, and LZ calls 86% of them "awake" (real wake: 89%). Its wake-vs-N3 AUC is 0.967 on surrogates against 0.982 on real data, so 97% of its separation survives when only the spectrum is kept. Phase-normalised LZ is the only measure that passes, and only because it carries no wake-vs-N3 information at all (AUC 0.51).
  • T1 sealed test on DREAM Tononi Serial Awakenings (task #31)
    experiments/t1_dream/RESULTS.md    Rule applied:.
  • Theory × constraint scorecard (task #25, track B2)
    experiments/theory_scorecard/RESULTS.md    No theory explains more than 16 of the 58 in-scope constraints.
  • One sealed open-data test per theory (task #16)
    experiments/theory_tests/RESULTS.md

The code is public on GitHub; paths are relative to its root. Sealed pre-registrations are in docs/prereg/, with their fingerprints in docs/prereg/HASHES.txt.

Goal: find the most accurate theory of human consciousness, by 2027.
